description: This file defines a command handler class for deleting loan applications within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses the LoanApplicationWritePlatformService to perform the deletion.

classes.name: LoanApplicationDeletionCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class that processes delete requests for loan applications, integrating with the service layer to perform the deletion.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the write platform service to delete the specified loan application.
